devdoc.details: interacts with LiquidityPool via hedgeDelta, getDelta, getPoolDenominatedValue and withdraw,       interacts with Rage Trade and chainlink via the change position, update and sync

returns.collatToTransfer: the amount of collateral required to return the margin account back to the health factor
returns.health: the health factor of the account currently
returns.isAboveMax: is the margin above the health factor
returns.isBelowMin: is the margin below the health factor

returns.value: the value of the reactor in the liquidity pool asset

params.delta: The exposure of the liquidity pool that the reactor needs to hedge against

returns.deltaChange: The difference in delta exposure as a result of strategy execution

returns._0: the amount actually withdrawn from the reactor denominated in the liquidity pool asset

devdoc.title: A hedging reactor that will manage delta by opening or closing short or long perp positions using rage trade

checkVaultHealth().notice: function to check the health of the margin account

clearingHouse().notice: instance of the clearing house interface

collateralAsset().notice: collateralAsset used for collateralising the pool

collateralId().notice: collateralId to be used in the perp pool

getDelta().notice: Returns the delta exposure of the reactor

getPoolDenominatedValue().notice: Returns the value of the reactor denominated in the liquidity pool asset

hedgeDelta(int256).notice: Execute a strategy to hedge delta exposure

initialiseReactor().notice: function to deposit 1 wei of USDC into the margin account so that a margin account is made, cannot be         be called if an account already exists

keeper(address).notice: address of the keeper of this pool

parentLiquidityPool().notice: address of the parent liquidity pool contract

poolId().notice: poolId to be used in the perp pool

priceFeed().notice: address of the price feed used for getting asset prices

setSyncOnChange(bool).notice: set whether changing a position should trigger a sync before updating

swapRouter().notice: instance of the uniswap V3 router interface

sync().notice: function to poke the margin account to update the profits of the vault

syncAndUpdate().notice: function to poke the margin account to update the profits of the vault and also manage         the collateral to safe bounds.

syncOnChange().notice: should change position also sync state

update().notice: Handle events such as collateralisation rebalancing

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraw a given asset from the hedging reactor to the calling liquidity pool.
